title: Analog And Digital Electronics
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mathematical process of determining the area under a curve."
Integrator Integration is a mathematical process of determining the area under a curve.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a metallic material attached to an integrated circuit chip or a high power dissipating transistor."
A heat sink is a metallic material attached to an integrated circuit chip or a high power dissipating transistor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the setting up of the DC voltages and current in an electronic circuit."
Biasing can be defined as the setting up of the DC voltages and current in an electronic circuit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the rate of change of output voltage with output current."
Vo Output resistance is defined as the rate of change of output voltage with output current.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an electronic circuit which makes logic decisions."
A logic gate is an electronic circuit which makes logic decisions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are derived to simplify circuit analysis."
Ideal Op-Amp The Ideal Op Amp parameters are derived to simplify circuit analysis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to calculate VIN; VOUT is the input to the voltage divider and VIN is the output of the voltage divider."
The voltage divider rule is used to calculate VIN; VOUT is the input to the voltage divider and VIN is the output of the voltage divider.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a circuit or device that provides a well specified, constant and stable DC voltage supply to other circuits."
A voltage regulator is a circuit or device that provides a well specified, constant and stable DC voltage supply to other circuits.
fib: ______ is a three-terminal semiconductor device that can be used for amplification and switching.
transistor
A transistor is a three-terminal semiconductor device that can be used for amplification and switching.
______ is the simplest but its average dc voltage output is low and it has a large amount of ripple which has a frequency equal to the input frequency.
half wave rectifier
The half wave rectifier is the simplest but its average dc voltage output is low and it has a large amount of ripple which has a frequency equal to the input frequency.
______ is a system in which the input signal is modified by the system output before the internal processing by the system itself.
feedback system
A feedback system is a system in which the input signal is modified by the system output before the internal processing by the system itself.
______ is the intersection of the Ic and the Vce on the load line for any particular base current.
Q point (operating Point)
Q point
The Q point (operating Point) is the intersection of the Ic and the Vce on the load line for any particular base current.
______ is defined as the area on the V and I curve within which the device can be operated without the risk of failure or degradation.
SOA
The SOA is defined as the area on the V and I curve within which the device can be operated without the risk of failure or degradation.
______ is made up of a Semiconductor region known as the Channel with ohmic contacts at each end.
JFET
The JFET is made up of a Semiconductor region known as the Channel with ohmic contacts at each end.
______ is an integration of the instantaneous current over the half cycle.
Mathematically the average current Idc
Mathematically the average current Idc is an integration of the instantaneous current over the half cycle.
______ is a completely mechanical method of performing this simplification, and so has an advantage over manipulation of expressions using Boolean algebra.
Karnaugh map
A Karnaugh map is a completely mechanical method of performing this simplification, and so has an advantage over manipulation of expressions using Boolean algebra.
